messages.author: 116e913a1348989c
messages.subject: affymetrix_calvin_exceptions::FileNotOpenException
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying out FIRMA on a set of exon array data and ran into this
error when fitting FirmaModel:

terminate called after throwing an instance of
'affymetrix_calvin_exceptions::FileNotOpenException'
Abort

There is an empty residuals.CEL file in the plmData directory.
However, I was able to run "getChipEffectSet" and write
chipEffects.CEL files in the same directory. The same error occured
when I ran "calculateResiduals" as well.

I appreciate your help on this!

Hi Elizabeth,

I was not able to get trackback info and R was aborted automatically
with the error
Please see below the code I ran followed by sessionInfo()

Thank you!
Lili

library(aroma.affymetrix)
verbose <- Arguments$getVerbose(-8)
timestampOn(verbose)
chipType <- "HuEx-1_0-st-v2"
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType(chipType,
tags="core,A20071112,EP")
print(cdf)
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("312_tissues", cdf=cdf)
setCdf(cs,cdf)

bc <- RmaBackgroundCorrection(cs, tag="core")
csBC <- process(bc,verbose=verbose)
qn <- QuantileNormalization(csBC, typesToUpdate="pm")
csN <- process(qn, verbose=verbose)

plmTr <- ExonRmaPlm(csN, mergeGroups=TRUE)
fit(plmTr, verbose=verbose,force=F)
cesTr <- getChipEffectSet(plmTr)

firma <- FirmaModel(plmTr)
fit(firma, verbose=verbose)
fs <- getFirmaScores(firma)

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: affymetrix_calvin_exceptions::FileNotOpenException
parts:
Hi,

ay ay ay, first of all you have to update the package; then one you
have is more than 4 months old and that is really old in our terms.
See online instructions how to do that. We will *not* spend time
troubleshooting anything not running the latest version.

Some quick comments: I don't know what happened. It can be a one-time
glitch somewhere, a corrupt file, a file system error. At least it
isn't something I've seen before. If you try to run it again (without
removing any files), does the error occur again? It will be very
helpful if you can turn on verbose, set it to say, verbose <- -20,
and rerun. Then report back approx 20-30 lines of the output before
the error. That might help us identify where it happens. Do all this
on with the new version installed.

Cheers

/Henrik
